_purpose: Pinned exit code per enforcement control. scripts/enforcement/ci-baseline.mjs fails the job when a control does WORSE than its baseline, or when a control cannot be measured at all. Known debt is permitted and pinned here; new debt is not. This is the ratchet that replaces continue-on-error, which reported success on a failing control.
_howToChange: Lower a baselineExit when the debt is actually cleared, in the same commit that clears it. Never RAISE a baselineExit to make a red build green — that converts a defect into a specification and makes the eventual fix read as a regression.
_tiers: BLOCKING means the control has been verified by violation: it was made to fail on an injected defect and observed passing again after a byte-identical restore. REPORTING means it runs and is ratcheted but has not been violation-verified, so its green is weaker evidence.

controls.knownDebt: none on a clean tree; matcher skips .git metadata. A dirty integration tree still flags tracked citers of real untracked _inbox paths; that is the real defect class, measured in CI clones not on the planner's dirty checkout.
controls.starvationNote: GRADUATION REVERTED 2026-08-21 by planner review of R-05. The matcher fix is correct and stays: a prose mention of .git/ is no longer a citation. The graduation to BLOCKING is not. The control fires only on a cited path that EXISTS ON DISK and is not in git (see its own header). A CI checkout has no untracked files by construction, so it can never fire there. Verified in a clean worktree at 5daf7c7: target present and untracked -> exit 2; target absent, which is the actual CI shape -> exit 0. BLOCKING on a control that cannot fail where it runs is a green that means nothing, and marking it BLOCKING makes that worse by implying enforcement.
controls.graduationItem: Change the semantics so it can fire in CI: flag a tracked file citing a repo-relative path that is NOT IN GIT, whether or not it exists on disk. A citation to a path that does not exist is a broken reference and is a real canon defect visible in a clean checkout. That will light up (1,190 candidate hits in the dirty tree, unknown share of them genuinely broken), so it lands as its own row, not as a tier flip.
